requests.summary: Heavenly Bodies: playtest NEEDS-FIXES and the Bar Raiser VETO is active (7.4-point first-seat advantage in 2-player games, caused by one interpretation: gap G4, first player draws on turn 1). Critic REVISE-MAJOR, average 2.83 (originality 4, clarity 2, fun 3, balance 2, market fit 3, production 3). Strength: the orbit-as-clock rotation is a fresh, skill-rich core (strategic beats random by 77.7 points). Weakness: the two win paths are not co-equal (2 players 72/28 Star Destruction, 6 players 25/75 Critical Mass), HP outweighs Star ability, and 40 rule gaps remain. Most of this is your locked rules, not the card set.

These are YOUR decisions (the critic's recommendation in brackets): (1) G4, first player skips the turn-1 draw [yes: gives a 50.2% seat split and clears the veto]; (2) make 2-player the primary mode and scale the Critical Mass threshold with player count [yes]; (3) buff the HP 5 Star abilities (ST08, ST10, ST11) rather than flatten the HP curve [yes]; (4) a free mulligan for an opening hand with no CO [yes]; (5) rule on G1, G4, G7, G8, G10, G12/13, G27 and G29 (the sim did not use the locked LIFO stack, G29); (6) reword the 'zero dead cards' target. Card-only fixes are cheap and clearly diagnosed (re-cost AE28 and AE25, more answers to Critical Mass, fewer dead AEs).
requests.expected_outcome: After you answer decisions 1, 2 and 5, a revision re-costs and re-writes cards within your rules and the playtester re-runs the simulation with your rulings. Targets: seat gap 5 or less, win paths within about 40/60 at 2 and 4 players, critic average 3.5 or more, veto cleared.
